prose: An engineer who helped build Meta's Mononoke source control server argues that Anthropic's new version-control system Scion copies the 'derived data' idea Mononoke used to speed up operations such as blame. He compares Anthropic's description with his own 2022 write-up.
His complaint is about credit: Anthropic mentioned Sapling's lessons but not Mononoke, and the post reads as if Claude designed it all. He says it borders on plagiarism. This is one engineer's view.
highlights: Ex-Meta engineer says Scion's derived-data design mirrors Mononoke.
He says Anthropic's credit is inadequate.
